description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source test management system. It compares different versions of requirements, generating diffs, handling linked custom fields, and rendering comparison views. It includes functions for fetching requirement data, preparing diff outputs, and initialization routines, indicating its role as a core component of the requirements comparison feature.

methods.name: getBareBonesReq
methods.description: Fetch minimal requirement details such as document ID and name based on requirement ID.

methods.name: getItemsToCompare
methods.description: Retrieve two specific items (left and right) from a set for comparison.

methods.name: getCFToCompare
methods.description: Get linked custom fields for the two items to be compared.

methods.name: getCFDiff
methods.description: Compare linked custom fields between two items, highlighting differences and formatting dates.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initialize and parse request arguments for requirement comparison.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Setup GUI object with requirement history and configuration settings.

methods.name: prepareUserFeedback
methods.description: Prepare display data for the comparison view, including version and revision info.

methods.name: getAttrDiff
methods.description: Compare specific requirement attributes such as status, type, and expected coverage.
